# Frog, phase 3 (run with --no-save, after p2_form.txt): the game's parts. The throat sac: an
# ellipsoid under the chin, its origin at the chin (the point it inflates from), set at the world
# origin so the bake places the pivot where the scene entry says. Then the body in five skins.
# Generated by make_frog.py.
material new Sac --base-color 0.9765 0.8510 0.3333 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Sac --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location 0 -0.34 0.28
scale 0.2 0.17 0.16
apply --scale
material assign Sac
shade flat
cursor set 0 -0.24 0.36
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
export sac.glb --selection
material set Skin base-color 0.2353 0.6078 0.5294
select Frog
export frog_green.glb --selection
material set Skin base-color 0.7922 0.1176 0.0588
select Frog
export frog_red.glb --selection
material set Skin base-color 0.9176 0.6157 0.0941
select Frog
export frog_gold.glb --selection
material set Skin base-color 0.1686 0.8118 0.9490
select Frog
export frog_blue.glb --selection
material set Skin base-color 0.7686 0.1059 0.8902
select Frog
export frog_violet.glb --selection
